headline: Young Harris lead on points and on goals
dek: Young Harris have won all three of their conference matches and drawn the two they played outside it. Their fourteen goals are more than any other programme has scored, and they have conceded four; only Lees-McRae have let in fewer.

pattern.label: derived
pattern.text: Southern Wesleyan have scored thirteen goals from nine different scorers and have lost three matches, more than either programme above them on the chart.

wire.line: King have lost every match they have played; Lees-McRae have yet to lose one.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Sixteen matches dated before today carry no result at all, the earliest Converse's home match against Spartanburg Methodist on Aug 13 and the latest Mount Olive's visit to Virginia State on Sep 4.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: King have lost all five of their matches, scoring three goals and conceding sixteen; only two players have scored for them.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Enzo Joly, a freshman, has five of Emmanuel's twelve goals, from fifteen shots.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Chowan's first win of the season came at home to Erskine on Sep 12, after two draws and two defeats.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Vicent Sanchis has been beaten five times for Francis Marion and has kept two clean sheets.

last_match.line: Young Harris have won every conference match they have played; King have lost every match of any kind.

next_match.line: Emmanuel have won both of their conference matches away from home; Converse have drawn their last two.

validation.policy: observed and derived claims are recomputed against the data home before publish; failures are dropped, not softened. signal and projected pass on schema unless the data contradicts a figure. context is never validated as a finding.
